query: Считывай сообщения из Kafka topic orders, преобразуй JSON в строки таблицы и записывай их в PostgreSQL.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: kafka_to_pg_orders_pipeline
  name: Kafka to PostgreSQL Orders Sync
  description: Reads JSON messages from Kafka orders topic, transforms them to table
    rows, and writes to PostgreSQL.
triggers:
- id: trigger_kafka_event
  type: event
  condition: new message in orders topic
sources:
- id: source_kafka_orders
  name: Read Kafka Orders
  type: Kafka
  location: orders
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
      group_id: etl_consumer_group
processing_elements:
- id: process_json_to_rows
  name: Transform JSON to Table Rows
  operation: Transform
  config:
    input_format: json
    output_format: tabular
    mapping_strategy: auto_flatten
sinks:
- id: sink_pg_orders
  name: Write to PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DB_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USER}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processed_data:
- id: orders_tabular_data
  format: tabular
links:
- from_id: source_kafka_orders
  to_id: process_json_to_rows
  data_ref: orders_tabular_data
- from_id: process_json_to_rows
  to_id: sink_pg_orders
  data_ref: orders_tabular_data
